bat.about: fair balls on the 4 demo pitches (deterministic; the 18-pitch sweep is in bat.py)

bat_flow.about: athlete body: flow of the whole motion as SEEN, leg lift -> contact + 0.8 s (bat.py flow_terms): per phase (lift -> plant, plant -> contact, contact -> contact + 0.8 s) the deepest valley of the MEASURED contraction speed (legs, trunk, arms, whole body; 25 ms smoothing) = max(dip below the lesser of its 0.3 s flanking peaks, stall below 25 % of them / 100 ms), summed over the phases, plus the worst command hold (/100 ms) or velocity step (/peak) from the leg lift (legs to contact; trunk and arms to contact + 0.45 s or the finish); lower is smoother; one pitch per seed from the 18-pitch sweep; a missed pitch adds 1.0

bat_power.about: athlete body: sweet-spot bat speed (6 in from the tip) at contact, m/s, one pitch per seed from the 18-pitch sweep; a miss scores 0

bat_power_clean.about: athlete body: bat_power's metric (sweet-spot bat speed 6 in from the tip at contact, m/s, one pitch per seed from the 18-pitch sweep; a miss scores 0) with a hitch-free guard: on EVERY pitch the swing's bat_flow score (bat.py flow_terms over leg lift -> contact + 0.8 s, plus 1.0 for a miss) must be at most 3.0 (bat.py CLEAN_FLOW; metric flow_ok), else the rollout scores as a failed guard. sprint_blocks_100.about: 100 m: sprint from starting blocks, v3 body (task sprint_blocks; challengers may bring another body with --task, e.g. sprint_blocks_v2): set position = the `set` of playground/refs/bolt/bolt_keyframes.json (the 2018 World Indoor finalists' literature set: Bolt's video set pose is unreliable, sha256 7c5b30bac12f3c2e...), pads under the soles, gun at 1.4 s; rules: false start = hand or foot or pelvis moving in the set or a block-force reaction under 0.100 s (World Athletics TR 16.6); fall = anything but the feet (and the hands before they leave) touching the track, or the pelvis / torso limits; times from the gun to the chest crossing the line; 12 held-out perturbed set positions (joints N(0, 0.02) rad, pitch N(0, 0.01) rad); metric t100 (s, lower is better); guards: no false start, no fall before the line
